critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/war/WarMap.tsx — clean 116-line component. Palette limited to 3 colours (OWN gold #E3C16F, RIVAL crimson #B3162B, WAR flame #FF4D3D) as requested; 3D feel achieved via top/bottom edge overlays (rgba(255,255,255,0.28) top + rgba(0,0,0,0.42) bottom) rather than transforms — cheap and consistent. Own tiles get an extra corner dot testID='war-own-<id>' for scanability. Legend explicitly shows the number of own nodes ('Tuo territorio · N nodi'). Centroid math computes the average of own-node coords (+0.5 CELL offset for cell center) then focus() at scale 1.6 — matches the review request. Auto-focus on mount via useEffect with 350 ms timeout is a nice touch (viewers land on their territory immediately).

/app/frontend/src/ui/ZoomPan.tsx — imperative API (focus/reset/panBy), content-size aware (minScale=Math.min(1,width/cw,height/ch)), pan is clamped to content bounds, pan gesture only enabled when zoomed>MIN*1.02 so vertical page scroll keeps working. panBy auto-zooms to MIN*2 if user D-pads while at min scale — good UX. D-pad step = 30% of viewport width, appropriate for a 366px viewport. Only nit: pan directions are inverted from cursor conventions (pan-right moves content left) which is standard for mobile map navigation and correct here.

/app/frontend/app/alliance/war.tsx — 116-line orchestrator: pulls /wars/map + /wars, computes contested set, wires WarMap→node-sheet→declare, and renders WarRow accordions with inline war-detail panel containing WarReplay. Roster picker (roster-pick-<pid>) capped at 10 with 36px pill height. Correct affordances: declare-war-button only visible to officer+ on non-own nodes, save-roster-button only during prep.

/app/backend/app/domain/wars.py:307-341 — resolution flow is transactional-ish: reads snapshot, calls resolve_lanes (10-lane 1v1), inserts season_points delta, awards war_coins per participant + winner bonus, sets result+resolved status atomically via a single update_one. Idempotent because the second /tick has no 'prep|locked' wars left to match (existing test_alliance_wars.py test_full_flow already confirms war_coins don't double on re-tick).

Nit (non-blocking): /app/frontend/src/war/WarMap.tsx line 41 useEffect deps use ESLint-disable exhaustive-deps because it depends on centroid?.x/y only. Fine as-is; goMine is stable enough within the render cycle.

Nit: The war-shift+tick pattern is necessary — war-shift alone only rewinds timestamps, the tick_once() call runs the state machine. Test hooks doc could hint at this to save future testing agents an iteration.

seed_data_creation: None new; used existing seed_war_demo state. Test consumed the QAT vs ORS node 22 attack (1 attack/24h) — subsequent runs will auto-clear via _test/war-shift include_resolved:true. No data corruption; ORS retained node 22 (defender won 9-1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full war simulation pattern: (1) POST /_test/war-shift {seconds:100000, include_resolved:true} to age out any pending prep/locked/resolved wars + attack_cooldown; (2) POST /_test/tick to run state machine; (3) POST /wars/declare {node_id} where node_id is 4-neighbour of any QAT-owned node — QAT owns nodes 20 (home) and 21 initially. Adjacent set: {19, 22, 2, 3, 39, 40}. Node 21 becomes owned after first successful capture (already conquered in earlier iterations, expect 400 own_node on it). Node 22 = ORS home castle (adjacency works, wins requires strong roster). (4) POST /wars/roster {war_id, player_ids:[10 ids from /alliances/mine members]} → attacker roster set. (5) Login as orsi.leader@idle1.app / QaBot!2026 (ORS leader) or orsi.bot1 for defender roster same endpoint. (6) POST /_test/war-shift {seconds:28800} + /_test/tick → status=locked. (7) POST /_test/war-shift {seconds:1800} + /_test/tick → status=resolved. Result object fields: {attacker_won:bool, attacker_points:int, defender_points:int, winner_alliance_id:str|null, captured:bool, tie_break_used:bool, lanes:list[10], resolved_at:iso}. NOTE the field is 'attacker_won' NOT 'winner' (no string winner field). Chat: GET /chat/messages?channel=alliance:<alliance_id>. WarMap testIDs: war-zoom (root), war-map (inner grid), war-node-<0..360>, war-own-<node_id> (only for own nodes), war-map-legend, war-goto-mine. ZoomPan controls: <base>-zoom-in, <base>-zoom-out, <base>-zoom-reset (conditional), <base>-pan-up/down/left/right, <base>-zoom-controls, <base>-dpad. WarReplay testIDs: war-replay, war-replay-score, war-replay-lanes, war-replay-arena, war-replay-lane-label, war-replay-lane-result, war-replay-toggle, war-replay-skip. Login testIDs: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button. Backend conftest imports 'from server import app' → must set PYTHONPATH=/app/backend when running pytest from /app; otherwise ModuleNotFoundError.
